main_text.head: DAVIDIS PAREI Exercitationum Philosophicarum & Theologicarum
LIBER IV.
main_text.p: Orationes sacras de anniversariis Ecclesiæ festis continens.
main_text.head: ORATIO I. DE NATIVITATE D. N. Jesu Christi.
main_text.p: Recitata publicè in Academia Heidelbergensi. à J. Georgio Wendelino Geyero Sapientia alumno. 24. Decemb. 1584.
MIRAMINI forsan, Auditores, quid sit, quòd ego, vix ab ulla re, quæ ad præsentem locum tempusque requiritur, instructus, verba factu-rus huc prodeam. Etenim hoc tempus

page.notes: The title block is set in roman capitals and italics; the year "1584" is printed in italic spaced figures. The initial M is a large woodcut letter joined to "IRAMINI" as "MIRAMINI". The word "tempus" at the line end continues on the next page. Some faint show-through from the reverse page is visible in the right and left margins and is not transcribed.
